description: Reserved matters application pursuant to condition 3 (layout; scale; appearance; access; landscaping) of hybrid planning permission 20/2784 (as amended), dated 15th June 2021, for layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping of Phase 4b comprising the demolition of existing buildings and structures and construction of residential units (Use Class C3) and affordable workspace (Use Class E), together with associated car parking, cycling parking, residential communal and private amenity space, landscaping and public realm works, refuse and servicing arrangements and ancillary facilitating works.
